title: RETHINKING CROSS-LINGUAL ALIGNMENT: BALANCING TRANSFER AND CULTURAL ERASURE IN MULTILINGUAL LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on the culturally-adaptive BLEND benchmark to quantify 'cultural erasure', which is the functional loss of providing culturally-situated responses across different query languages.
Measuring the proportion of times the model selects multiple-choice answer options associated with English-speaking countries (US/UK) when prompted with non-English queries.
